what is One World Trade Center?

One World Trade Center is the main building of the rebuilt World Trade Center complex in Lower Manhattan, New York City. It is the second - tallest freestanding structure building in the Western Hemisphere, and the sixth - tallest in the world. It is also known as 1 World Trade Center, 1 WTC or Freedom Tower. One World Trade Center surpasses the height of Taipei 101, is the world 's tallest all - office building, and the fourth - tallest skyscraper in the world , behind the Burj Khalifa, Abraj Al Bait, and Shanghai Tower.
Who built the One World Trade Center and why?

Daniel R. Tishman, along with his father John Tishman, led the construction team from Tishman Realty & Construction to build the One World Trade Center. It is built to memorialize the September 11 attacks and to rebuild the complex.
I want to know who owns it now and if all the spaces in the building are leased out.

The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey is the primary owner of One World Trade Center. Approximately 5 percent of the building's equity has been sold to the Durst Organization, a private real estate company. Not all the spaces in the building are leased. As of November 2014, the lease occupancy rate had increased to 62.8 percent.
How was the location of the One World Trade Center decided?

The location of the One World Trade Center was originally planned to be on the east side of Lower Manhattan. However, due to disagreements between the New Jersey and New York state governments, which oversee the Port Authority, the location was shifted to the site of the H&M's Hudson Terminal on the Lower West Side of Manhattan after several meetings.
